logic.entry: At a newly completed UTC daily bar i, enter long only when C[i-1] > arithmetic_mean(C[i-300:i]) * (1 + 0.50%); SMA uses the 300 most recent completed daily closes including C[i-1].
logic.exit: When long, exit when C[i-1] < arithmetic_mean(C[i-300:i]) * (1 - 0.50%); otherwise retain prior desired state. Equality and values inside the symmetric band retain state.
logic.sizing: Independent unlevered long-only spot account, initial capital 2000 USDT; buy maximum affordable quantity after signal close at next UTC day 00:01 one-minute open; preserve cash/units; terminal liquidation is costed. No pre-OOS fills, leverage, shorting, rebalancing, or cross-asset transfer.
logic.signal_timing: Daily input is closed UTC candles only; last closed signal is available before next-day 00:01 UTC execution.
